_comment: Field selection for the gnomAD joint callset (variants parquet).
This is an INCLUDE-list: 'load': true is what reaches the parquet.
Generated from the v4.1 chr21 VCF header; 664 INFO fields.
A future gnomAD release adding fields will surface them here as
load:false rather than silently widening the schema.
Applied at build time. ADR-003 bundles are immutable, so a variant
dropped here is absent from that bundle for good.
Measured on chr21: AC_joint=0 is 49.5% of records, singletons are
null disables a bound. Bounds are inclusive.
